request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT

layers.text: This walker has two legs and needs three. Draw one new front leg in the empty space in the middle, between the left leg and the right leg: a thick straight dark gunmetal leg from the middle of the body down to the bottom of the image, with a round chrome knee and a big chrome foot. Empty gaps on both sides of it. Three legs in all. Keep the chrome hood, the magenta eye lens, the heat-ray arm, the two other legs, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
